goal: Compiler errors that help developers actually correct syntax.
problem: A developer can receive compiler errors without a correct source location or a correct actionable syntax correction, regardless of who introduced the error or improved the compiler.
acceptedPartialOutcome: For a full native-accepted original with exactly one numeric-engine mutation, the actual native diagnostic identifies the exact file and line, with its column inside either the engine-key token or the invalid numeric-value token (not whitespace or unrelated text). Separately, a unique explicit native correction restores that same accepted original.
scope: A deliberately closed numeric-engine oracle, not a general YAML parser, general compiler reimplementation, full diagnostic-quality score or usability judgment.

sourceReadBoundary.compilerAndDiagnostics: Read and preserved complete selected compiler, frontmatter, schema diagnostic and console formatting sources, including native ValidationResult/ValidationIssue declarations and tests.
sourceReadBoundary.compiledWorkflow: Exact path is known but its blob is not readable from the authorized cache with GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1. It was not reconstructed from Markdown.
sourceReadBoundary.optionalRuntimeImport: The optional .github/shared-instructions.md does not exist in the frozen tree.
sourceReadBoundary.toolchain: go.mod blob is not readable in the authorized cache; no source or compiler execution, build or dependency installation was attempted.

temporalSemantics.activationMeaning: The source-era lower bound is the actual frozen source commit time, not a claimed workflow adoption or the time this contract was authored. Evaluation is current-source-only reconstruction under that exact revision.
temporalSemantics.historicalSourceProfiles: Not acquired. Earlier native evidence has not been exhausted; do not backdate the current predicate.
temporalSemantics.diagnosticCohorts: One-day intervals with inclusive starts and exclusive ends; the leading short cohort is interim. Select by original native execution completion time, not issue creation, merge, source commit or archive acquisition.
temporalSemantics.deliveryCohorts: Separate one-day inclusive/exclusive merge-time intervals, only after native before/after evidence and actual workflow-linked delivery are independently established. No delivered value is currently produced.
temporalSemantics.comparison: No pre-adoption baseline, native observations, comparable recent change, causal effect, keep threshold or utility/savings estimate is established.

antecedentExistence.phenomenon: Pre-existing independently of this workflow; human compiler improvements count equally.
antecedentExistence.reconstruction: Current-source checker implemented. No original historical compiler/input receipts acquired and no historical profiles tested.
antecedentExistence.disposition: Primary partial native facet in percent; missing originals return null.

antecedentExistence.reconstruction: Same original input pair and native outputs as location facet; never infer a repair from words such as hint or from an agent score.
antecedentExistence.disposition: Separate diagnostic partial facet in percent; not averaged with location.

antecedentExistence.reconstruction: No independent native task instrument or original task receipts acquired.
antecedentExistence.disposition: Full usability unavailable, not replaced by the producing agent's clarity/actionability judgments.

antecedentExistence.phenomenon: Compiler improvement pre-exists; workflow-specific linkage does not establish the outcome.
antecedentExistence.reconstruction: Editable issue/PR inventory is discovery only. No original producer receipt, accepted graph, merge/parent diff and paired native diagnostics acquired.
antecedentExistence.disposition: Unavailable and separate from actor-independent partial attainment.

workflowNativeMeasureDispositions.measure: Clarity /25, actionability /25, context /20, examples /15, consistency /15, total /100
workflowNativeMeasureDispositions.disposition: Rejected as measured usability. Producing-agent assessments, not independently established repository outcomes.

workflowNativeMeasureDispositions.measure: Average >=65 and individual >=50; conflicting >=70 issue guideline
workflowNativeMeasureDispositions.disposition: Workflow output-routing gates only. Neither threshold is a utility target, keep bar or operational-value formula.

workflowNativeMeasureDispositions.measure: Two workflows, two categories, error output captured, issue/noop, at most 20 turns and ten calls
workflowNativeMeasureDispositions.disposition: Coverage, process or efficiency diagnostics, never successful correction or delivered improvement.
Format alone is insufficient. Retain only objectively correct key locations and exact independently accepted restoration repairs in the bounded native facet.

workflowNativeMeasureDispositions.measure: Issue creation, closure, merge, editable marker or related PR
workflowNativeMeasureDispositions.disposition: Discovery/lifecycle, not acceptance, usability or attribution.

independenceAndCustody: Native before/after compile JSON and native go version -m bytes are decoded, never aggregate caller trust flags. Local preserved originals still require an authoritative custody boundary; checksum verification alone is not proof of origin. The production evidence archive is intentionally empty rather than populated with validation fixtures.

readiness.source: Partial: full workflow/imports and selected native compiler/diagnostic sources retained; compiled workflow and go.mod blobs unreadable.
readiness.checker: Implemented for the closed current-source native location/restoration facet; positive, negative, malformed, trust-flag and boundary tests are included.
readiness.fullFunction: Partial only: full developer usability and actual workflow-linked delivery are not implemented as accepted measures.
readiness.nativeProducer: Unavailable: the frozen workflow does not persist the input/result/build-info evidence needed by this collector.
readiness.evidence: Discovery archive verified in full (346 partitions, 58048 entities); 69 syntax workflow candidates retained as discovery only; zero native cases acquired.
readiness.historicalEvidence: Unacquired, not exhausted. No acquisition or resumption is authorized.
